title: Sebastian and the Harbor
author: Wren Dunmore
blurb: Ansel Zhou, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
